name: House of Dream
source:
You wake up in a dream that is not yours, trapped in a house outside of reality with Emi, the owner of the home, who greets you with a smile :], but your goal is to wake up and return to the real world.

[From [url=https://emicarnationproduction.itch.io/house-of-dream]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在一个不属于你的梦中醒来，被困在现实之外的房子里，和房子的主人艾米一起，她微笑着迎接你:]，但你的目标是醒来并回到现实世界。

[来自[url=https://emicarnationproduction.itch.io/house-of-dream]itch.io[/url]]
